title: The Realistic plan for the winter
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：realistic　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 realistic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1950 the keeper wrote of ① a realistic plan for the winter in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② more realistic than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the realistic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most realistic plan for the winter anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1944 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too realistic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the realistic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a realistic painting of the harbour, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as realistic as the painting of the harbour they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was realistic or not, and he said so.

By 1957 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something realistic, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite realistic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the realistic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1960, in public, she wrote of another realistic plan for the winter in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more realistic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most realistic painting of the harbour in the whole zoo, she said in 1962, was the one she could never quite name; the realistic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 现实（前置定语 a realistic plan for the winter：1950 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件现实的过冬计划）
B. adj. 现实／写实（比较级 more realistic than：文中两处，一处比切合实际的过冬计划，一处比预想）
C. adj. 现实／写实（最高级 the most realistic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 现实（表语 too realistic to do：母亲觉得它太现实，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 写实（前置定语 a realistic painting of the harbour：叔叔把整件事称作一桩写实的港口画）
F. adj. 写实（同级比较 as realistic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩写实的港口画相比）
G. adj. 写实（后置定语 something realistic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 写实（受程度副词修饰 quite realistic：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a realistic plan for the winter
the most realistic plan for the winter anybody
a realistic painting of the harbour
The most realistic painting of the harbour in

answers.why: realistic 意为“现实”，1950 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件现实的过冬计划”，此处作前置定语 a realistic plan for the winter。
realistic 意为“现实”，此处用比较级 more realistic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
realistic 意为“现实”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最现实的一件，故用最高级 the most realistic plan for the winter。
realistic 意为“现实”，母亲认为这件东西“太现实了，谁也用不上”，too realistic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
realistic 意为“写实”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩写实的港口画”，此处作前置定语 a realistic painting of the harbour。
realistic 意为“写实”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩写实的港口画一样写实”，同级比较用 as realistic as。
realistic 意为“写实”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“写实的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something realistic。
realistic 意为“写实”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当写实”，quite 修饰原级 realistic。
realistic 意为“写实”，1960 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要写实”，故用比较级 more realistic than。
realistic 意为“写实”，母亲 1962 年说的是“整个兽舍里最写实的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most realistic painting of the harbour。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1950 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件现实的过冬计划。（a realistic plan for the winter）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更现实。（more realistic than …）
母亲觉得它太现实，谁也用不上。（too realistic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩写实的港口画。（a realistic painting of the harbour）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩写实的港口画一样写实。（as realistic as …）
到了 1957 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件写实的东西。（something realistic）
answers: In 1950 the keeper wrote of a realistic plan for the winter in the register.
Everybody said it was more realistic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too realistic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a realistic painting of the harbour.
He said nobody would call it as realistic as the painting of the harbour they had once had.
By 1957 the register asked for nothing but something realistic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 realistic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1950 the keeper wrote of a realistic plan for the winter in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most realistic plan for the winter in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too realistic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a realistic painting of the harbour, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite realistic, and everybody laughed.
The realistic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
